claim: Direct message shares to individuals and total watch time are the top metrics driving algorithmic distribution on Instagram Reels.
quote: what do you tell people when they ask you what focus on shares... sending a post to another human... the third metric... watch time

claim: Instagram evaluates total watch time alongside watch rate, ensuring longer videos are not inherently penalized for lower percentage completion.
quote: we definitely don't want to just penalize things because they're longer... what matters more is just the over amount of time watch

claim: Contrary to creator belief, hashtags do not significantly increase reach on Instagram and are not a primary growth lever.
quote: hashtags are no longer a primary way to increase your reach on Instagram... it's just not an important thing for for reach

claim: Instagram's algorithm parses video context using keyframe visual analysis (16 to 128+ frames), audio transcription, and captions, prioritizing captions heavily.
quote: take key frames from the video... transcribe the audio into text... right now it's disproportionately looking at the caption relative to the video relative to the audio

claim: Instagram does not intentionally suppress organic reach to force creators into purchasing advertisements.
quote: People think that we suppress reach to get people to buy ads it doesn't make any sense... we are more than happy to grow engagement

claim: Engaging or replying to DMs right before or after posting does not directly trigger an algorithmic reach boost.
quote: does the algorithm reward me for that activity not directly indirectly it could happen... the way the ranking system works is it doesn't know that that's why

claim: Taking a break from posting for over a month causes a drop in initial post performance due to audience data signal decay rather than an account penalty.
quote: once you get to about a month... you probably realized most of that unfortunate loss in that first month or two... it's a byproduct of how we build things

claim: Instagram actively prioritizes original content creators over aggregator accounts by swapping original posts into recommendation slots.
quote: ideally the person who came up with the thing and made the thing gets more views than the person who found your thing

claim: Instagram never downranks or filters aggressive or borderline content sent to existing followers, restricting recommendation filters strictly to unconnected non-followers.
quote: We do not downrank content from people you follow because we think it might be offensive... ever... but if we just show you a post for some Rando... we take more precautions

claim: Sudden, dramatic single-day reach drops are typically caused by real-world event shifts and seasonality changes rather than major algorithm updates.
quote: small changes go out every day... If you see a huge swing in what's going on... it's probably more there was a huge change in the world

claim: Direct messaging a post 1-on-1 is algorithmically valued relatively equally to sharing a post to Stories due to high recipient intent and notification responses.
quote: I think they're valued relatively equally... when you send a message to one person... phone's going to Bing and she's going to open it up

claim: Using a banned or blocked hashtag will not cause an account strike or penalty; it simply prevents the hashtag from displaying as a hyperlink.
quote: it's not a Content violation and basically what will happen is it just won't turn into a link... it's not a strike

claim: Smaller niche creators can monetize effectively through Partner Ads, allowing brands to license top-performing content and run targeted ads directly.
quote: partner ads allow you to create content as a Creator... can help shift more dollars from the biggest craters to the little ones

claim: Unconnected recommendations in the main feed are the primary business vehicle for creators to reach non-followers on Instagram.
quote: recommendations was really just an the only viable way to maintain feed... your average crator reaches way more people in feed
